text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY18,000/Year instead of CNY 28,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply) Research Centers The school is equipped with a wide variety of sophisticated instruments, such as Infrared Spectrometer, Ultraviolet,visible Spectrometer, Fluorescence Spectrometer, Elementar, High Pressure/Performance Liquid Chromatography, Gel Permeation Chromatograph, Gas Chromatograph, Porosimeter, Universal Materials,Testing Machine,Thermal Analyzer, High resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy, Atomic Absorption Spectroscopy, Emission Spectrometer and other equipments for macro molecules or dope synthesizing and machining. In recent years, the school has successively undertaken more than 40 projects of scientific research founded by national or provincial programs. Several professional books and more than 600 papers are published. Faculty & Staff The school now has 150 teaching staffs, including 24 professors, 34 associate professors, 16 senior experimenters and engineers, and 70 doctors. The full-time undergraduate and the postgraduate students are more than 3000 and 100, respectively.
